t: In front of you on the Victoria Embankment, at the west end of Temple Place, stands a bronze statue of Isambard Kingdom Brunel. It's by the sculptor Carlo Marochetti, and it rests on a Portland stone pedestal with flanking screens and benches designed by the architect Richard Norman Shaw. Brunel was the first engineer of the Great Western Railway, and he designed its London to Bristol main line. He also built the largest steamships of his day: the Great Western, the Great Britain and the Great Eastern.
